saas.idea: A tool that chases unpaid invoices for freelancers so they stop doing it by hand. It watches due dates and sends the polite follow-up for you.
saas.who: Solo designers and developers who invoice 3–10 clients a month
saas.problem: Freelancers get paid late because chasing is awkward and easy to forget. They lose a day a month to it and still write off invoices.
saas.features:
Connect invoices from Stripe or a CSV
Reminder schedule per invoice
Editable message templates
Paid / overdue dashboard

churn.idea: A dashboard that flags which customer accounts are about to cancel, and says why, so a small success team knows who to call today.
churn.who: Customer success leads at 10–40 person B2B SaaS companies
churn.problem: Churn is only visible after it happens. Usage data exists but nobody has time to read it weekly.
churn.features:
Risk score per account
Signal breakdown
Weekly digest email
Owner assignment

ops.idea: A planner that shows a small studio's booked hours against available hours, so they know when to say yes to a new project.
ops.who: Owners of 3–12 person design and dev studios
ops.problem: Capacity lives in spreadsheets and heads. Studios overcommit, then scramble.
ops.features:
Per-person weekly capacity
Project allocation
Revenue forecast
Overcommit warnings

copilot.idea: An assistant that drafts support replies using the team's previous answers, and always shows which past ticket it borrowed from.
copilot.who: Two- to six-person support teams handling 200+ tickets a week
copilot.problem: Agents rewrite the same answer daily, and new hires cannot find the accepted wording.
copilot.features:
Draft reply from ticket history
Cited source tickets
One-click insert into inbox
Thumbs up/down learning

research.idea: An assistant that reads user-interview transcripts and clusters them into themes, keeping every claim linked to the exact quote.
research.who: Solo researchers and PMs running 5–20 interviews per study
research.problem: Synthesis takes longer than the interviews, and findings lose their evidence on the way to the deck.
research.features:
Transcript upload
Theme clustering
Quote-level citations
Export to doc

onboard.idea: An in-app guide that answers new users' questions about the product from the docs, and hands off to a human when confidence is low.
onboard.who: Product teams whose trial users drop off in week one
onboard.problem: New users hit a wall, do not read docs, and do not open a ticket. They just leave.
onboard.features:
Docs-grounded answers
In-app launcher
Low-confidence handoff
Unanswered-question log
